dependency_decisions: Preserve original guidance and all branches; apply only the counted local-path edits, standard header metadata/name, and prominent packaging modification notice.

Include the explicitly referenced CONNECTORS.md. Native MCP and plugin manifests describe optional environment setup and are not required read-only skill support; retain their original bytes in research evidence and link the exact configuration revision.
